robustness.description: Country-cluster bootstrap (Final_Code), 1000 resamples, set.seed(20261010), pairwise-complete Pearson matrix; T1 primary
robustness.note: 223 clusters (123 rows with missing Final_Code excluded from the pool; they enter no pair). Undefined T1 resamples: 0. Share of resamples with T1 >= 0.73: 0.007. p = min(2 x share T1 <= 0, 1). Secondary CIs: T2 [0.1170, 0.2316], T3 [0.4951, 0.5847], largest pair [0.5799, 0.7196] (share >= 0.73: 0.012), median [0.3500, 0.4610].

robustness.description: Influential-country exclusion: drop top 1% (ceiling, min 1) of countries by |leave-one-country-out change in T1|, recompute 7x7 matrix
robustness.note: 2 of 172 countries dropped: Botswana, Egypt (Final_Code 571, 651), 372 country-years in total, 82 with an ARD-AoW pair; n = 6199. T2 0.1776, T3 0.5399, largest pair AoW-ARD (0.6647), median 0.3992. p printed as 0 means below double precision.

robustness.description: Listwise common sample (all seven PDA dummies non-missing) instead of pairwise-complete observations
robustness.note: N = 6067. T2 0.2838, T3 0.5616, median 0.4319. Largest pair here is AoW-LIED (0.6695), not ARD-AoW; still below 0.73. p printed as 0 means below double precision.

env_fixes: none: no author file changed (see diffs/README.md); corrr 0.4.5 and pacman 0.5.1 installed from CRAN into the per-run library
class_reason: All six targets reproduced exactly at the paper's printed precision by running the authors' three scripts unmodified on the deposited Measures_merged.rds; all 21 Table 3 cells also match to 3 dp.
confidence_reason: Deterministic computation, unmodified code, deposited input file with matching checksum; final confidence also depends on agent B agreeing.
uncertainties: Code review: none found (bugs list empty). Read Comparison.R fully, Share_Common_Sample.R and Agreement across all.R fully; other scripts not reviewed. Unverified observation: Comparison.R lines 105, 176 and 183 relabel alphabetically ordered factor levels by position, so Figure 1 and Figure 4 labels depend on the collation locale; correct in this run (C.UTF-8, outputs/label_locale_check.csv), not tested under a locale that sorts upper case before lower case; consistent with the author's comment at line 104. Not on any target.
Input is the deposited merged file; the data preparation (Merging_measures.R, needs democracyData from GitHub) was not re-run, as the PREREG plan states.
Paper values come from PREREG.md, which read Table 3 from PDF-extracted text; the PDF bytes and the supplemental appendix were not available to this run.

Prose values noted in PREREG (highest correlation '.63', median '.39') differ from the rounded reproduced values 0.636 and median 0.3977 (outputs/targets_extracted.csv); Table 3 itself matches. Consistent with truncation in the prose; not a target.

R_a judgment call: 123 rows with missing Final_Code (only RoW non-missing, so they enter no correlation) were left out of the bootstrap cluster pool; with them as an extra cluster the random draws would differ.
R_b/R_c p-values are below double precision and stored as 0; R_a p = 0 means no bootstrap resample had T1 <= 0.
No version pins in the deposit; current CRAN/Debian versions used (corrr 0.4.5).
